paragraphs: All Heroes and Heritage Tours prices are quoted in CAD (Canadian Dollars).

A 30% deposit secures your booking with Heroes and Heritage Tours, with the balance due no later than twenty-one days before your tour departs. If you are booking within twenty-one days of your tour's departure date, full payment is required at the time of booking, as there is no time remaining to collect a balance payment.

All persons travelling with Heroes and Heritage Tours must have valid, comprehensive travel insurance at the time of the tour and must carry their emergency contact information with them at all times.
All persons who are legally required to carry a Passport must carry that Passport at all times during any tour.

Refund of Heroes and Heritage Tours Tour Fee/s is available for cancellations up to twenty-one days before the date of the Tour as booked. Refund of 50% is available for cancellations up to fourteen days before the date of the Tour. No refund is available for cancellations under fourteen days before the date of the Tour.

If you have booked a Tour and find yourself unable to attend on that date, you may move to an alternate date (if the newly requested date is available), provided that at least two full days' notice is given to Heroes and Heritage Tours.

Should Heroes and Heritage Tours be unable to deliver any proposed Tour, as booked, then Heroes and Heritage Tours' liability will be limited to a full refund of Heroes and Heritage Tours Tour Fees. No refund will be applicable in the event that any Tour is prevented due to Force Majeure.
All bookings are on a non-exclusive/shared basis. All Tours are conducted in English.
Entry fees are included in the booking fee. Inclusions vary by tour: accommodation and meals are included on select multi-day tours, so please refer to the individual tour page for full details.
